metadata.agent: Agent 3 — Legacy Clip Studio Native Parity

capabilities.name: source_select
capabilities.description: Select source long-form video from library/downloaded list for clipping.
capabilities.expected_output: List of DownloadedVideo objects with title, duration, aspect, path.
capabilities.project_mutation: Adds source asset into document['assets'] and binds to project timeline.

capabilities.name: source_preview
capabilities.description: Playback and preview of selected source media in player.
capabilities.project_mutation: Unified into Motion's single canonical player; no second preview player.

capabilities.name: filmstrip_generate
capabilities.description: Generate sampled filmstrip sprite sheet for timeline scrubbing.
capabilities.project_mutation: Cached in data directory; referenced by timeline track rendering.

capabilities.name: frame_extract
capabilities.description: Extract exact video frame image at specified timestamp.
capabilities.project_mutation: Used for hover preview and scrub frame inspection in canonical timeline.

capabilities.name: speech_transcribe
capabilities.description: Transcribe audio to timestamped words and sentences via Whisper.
capabilities.expected_output: List of segments with start, end, text, words.
capabilities.project_mutation: Recorded on project timeline captions track or document['transcripts'].

capabilities.name: segments_cache
capabilities.description: Retrieve cached word-level transcript segments for video.
capabilities.expected_output: { segments: [{start, end, text, words}], cached: bool }
capabilities.project_mutation: Zero retranscription if cached; reused directly in timeline.

capabilities.name: suggest_clips_ai
capabilities.description: Ask AI candidate highlight detection with virality scoring and hook ranker.
capabilities.params: max_clips, min_duration, max_duration, platform, genre, user_query
capabilities.expected_output: { job_id: str } -> suggestions: [{start, end, title, score, hook_score, hook_type, reason}]
capabilities.project_mutation: Stores proposed clips into document['bench_ranges'] for review in timeline.

capabilities.name: platform_bias
capabilities.description: Biases hook ranking toward platform style (tiktok, youtube_shorts, reels, linkedin, twitter).
capabilities.project_mutation: Embeds target_platform in project metadata and clip options.

capabilities.name: genre_bias
capabilities.description: Biases clip selection toward video genre (podcast, interview, tutorial, gaming, etc.).
capabilities.project_mutation: Embeds genre in project metadata.

capabilities.name: user_query_filter
capabilities.description: Filters candidate clips by user natural-language focus (e.g. 'find the pricing debate').
capabilities.project_mutation: Stored as query tag in project revision.

capabilities.name: bench_range_set
capabilities.description: Set, move, or resize in/out cut ranges on the timeline cutting bench.
capabilities.error_codes: Validation error on overlap or duration < 5s
capabilities.project_mutation: Updates document['bench_ranges'] with atomic CAS revision bump.

capabilities.name: bench_range_snap
capabilities.description: Snaps proposed cut boundaries to nearest sentence and speech unit boundaries.
capabilities.expected_output: Adjusted windows aligned to sentence pauses without clipped words.
capabilities.error_codes: Falls back to raw timestamps if no sentences found
capabilities.project_mutation: Clips positioned precisely at clean speech boundaries.

capabilities.name: bench_range_dedup
capabilities.description: Enforces non-overlapping constraint: eliminates intersecting cut ranges.
capabilities.project_mutation: Guarantees timeline clips do not collide or duplicate content.

capabilities.name: bench_topic_dedup
capabilities.description: Deduplicates candidate clips covering the exact same semantic topic/keyword set.
capabilities.expected_output: Diverse candidate list with topic uniqueness.
capabilities.project_mutation: Ensures varied output clips across long video.

capabilities.name: extract_clips_ai
capabilities.description: Extract top viral clips automatically via Whisper transcription and LLM picker.
capabilities.expected_output: { job_id: str } -> List of GeneratedVideo records and physical MP4 files.
capabilities.project_mutation: Populates canonical ProjectRevision tracks and produces export MP4s.

capabilities.name: extract_clips_manual
capabilities.description: Extract user-specified time ranges verbatim with post-processing.
capabilities.params: time_ranges: list[{start, end}], caption_style, emoji_style, remove_silence, force_vertical
capabilities.expected_output: { job_id: str } -> List of GeneratedVideo records and physical MP4 files.
capabilities.project_mutation: Translates manual ranges directly to timeline clips on media track.

capabilities.name: duration_fallback
capabilities.description: Evenly slices video duration into deliverables when AI picker returns 0 candidates.
capabilities.params: duration: float, max_clips: int, clip_duration: float = 60.0
capabilities.expected_output: List of window slices with clip_selection='duration_fallback'.
capabilities.project_mutation: Emits time slice clips flagged with duration_fallback in metadata.

capabilities.name: silence_remove
capabilities.description: Detects and cuts dead air / silent pauses > 0.5s and speech fillers.
capabilities.expected_output: Cleaned media file without awkward dead pauses.
capabilities.project_mutation: Updates clip duration and timing in project timeline.

capabilities.name: segment_retime
capabilities.description: Recalculates word and segment timestamps after audio chunks are cut.
capabilities.expected_output: Retimed segments matching shortened media timeline.
capabilities.project_mutation: Subtitles stay in 100% frame-perfect sync with edited media.

capabilities.name: reframe_vertical
capabilities.description: Transforms 16:9 landscape into 9:16 vertical using stacked background blur-fill.
capabilities.expected_output: 1080x1920 MP4 file with sharp centered video and blurred backdrop.
capabilities.project_mutation: Sets document['aspect_ratio'] = '9:16' and layout preset.

capabilities.name: captions_burn
capabilities.description: Burns synchronized ASS subtitles with word-level animation into MP4.
capabilities.project_mutation: Captions represented as editable items on captions track.

capabilities.name: captions_style
capabilities.description: Applies typography presets: viral, standard, minimal, toktok, cinematic, beast, etc.
capabilities.expected_output: ASS Style header with font, outline, shadow, color, margin.
capabilities.project_mutation: Stores caption style and parameters on track.

capabilities.name: emoji_density
capabilities.description: Injects relevant animated emojis into captions based on spoken keywords.
capabilities.project_mutation: Preserved in caption track item payload.

capabilities.name: metadata_generate
capabilities.description: Generates viral hook title, SEO description, and platform hashtags via LLM.
capabilities.error_codes: Provider error falls back to default metadata
capabilities.project_mutation: Saves metadata to project document and export attributes.

capabilities.name: virality_score_breakdown
capabilities.description: Calculates 5-factor scorecard: hook, flow, value, trend, shareability (1-10).
capabilities.expected_output: { hook: float, flow: float, value: float, trend: float, shareability: float }
capabilities.project_mutation: Saved in document['metadata']['virality_score_breakdown'].

capabilities.name: thumbnail_generate
capabilities.description: Extracts cover frame at hook peak (1.5s - 3.0s) for high CTR thumbnail.
capabilities.project_mutation: Saved to asset storage and referenced in project document.

capabilities.name: thumbnail_regenerate
capabilities.description: Regenerate clip thumbnail at custom playhead timecode.
capabilities.project_mutation: Bumps thumbnail cache-busting timestamp in project revision.

capabilities.name: clip_metadata_edit
capabilities.description: Update clip title, description, tags, virality score.
capabilities.project_mutation: Atomic CAS mutation updating project metadata.

capabilities.name: clip_stream
capabilities.description: Stream rendered clip with HTTP Range support for scrub and seek.
capabilities.project_mutation: Directly consumable by canonical Motion player.

capabilities.name: clip_stream_aspect
capabilities.description: Stream rendered clip for specific aspect (landscape vs portrait).
capabilities.project_mutation: Consumable by canonical Motion player with aspect switcher.

capabilities.name: clip_delete
capabilities.description: Delete clip record and purge media/thumbnail files from disk safely.
capabilities.project_mutation: Removes clip from timeline or archives project revision.

capabilities.name: timeline_project_map
capabilities.description: Maps extracted clip into Motion's single timeline, single player, single ProjectRevision.
capabilities.expected_output: Updated ProjectRevision with populated video, audio, and subtitle tracks.
capabilities.project_mutation: Bumps revision, inserts tracks, sets duration and aspect ratio.

capabilities.name: project_reopen
capabilities.description: Reopen saved project revision in Motion with 100% preservation of clips and tracks.
capabilities.project_mutation: Deterministic deserialization of schema_version 2 document.

capabilities.name: project_export_mp4
capabilities.description: Render and export canonical project composition to physical MP4 decoded by FFprobe.
capabilities.expected_output: Physical MP4 file with valid ffprobe audio/video streams.
capabilities.project_mutation: Creates output deliverable record and writes MP4 to disk.
